subject: [hw] DONE V15 rev 5: test breadth only (1764 checks)
body:
Rev 5: no implementation change since rev 4, only more unit cases so that the thin mnemonics have several independent operands each (BIC, RSB, TST, TEQ, CMN, MVN, SSAT16, USAT16, SBFX, UBFX, BFI, BFC, SUBW, MOVT, REV, REV16, REVSH, RBIT, CLZ, SEL, UMLAL/SMLAL/SMULL/UMAAL/MLS/SDIV/UDIV edge operands). One expectation of mine was wrong and is corrected: UMAAL with RdLo = RdHi = 0x80000000 and a zero product leaves RdLo = 0, RdHi = 1 (the two addends carry into RdHi).

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V15 PASS 1764/1764
    (ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2)

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/check_routing.sh
    V15-ROUTE PASS 10/10

Not done unchanged (no phone, T16/T32-mem/misc integration outside my files, ADC/SBC immediate untestable by assembly).
